candidate_structure.information_flow: The first call receives all common evidence, forms one complete executable closure, and binds public-contract conformance as immutable. The final call consumes that closure and retained public evidence without a direct candidate_hypothesis edge, preserves the locked boundary, revises behavior-bearing semantics using the predecessor artifact as the sole carrier of hypothesis influence, and emits one policy.
candidate_structure.name: Single-Use Hypothesis Contract Relay
candidate_structure.organization: two-call sequential lineage with one contract-locked executable handoff and upstream-only direct hypothesis visibility

calls.objective: Form exactly one complete executable policy closure from the supplied evidence, bind public-contract conformance as an immutable authority boundary, delegate only behavior-semantic revision, and pass the complete artifact forward.

Consume lock_contract_closure and the retained public evidence, treat the predecessor artifact as the sole carrier of hypothesis influence, preserve its locked contract conformance, exercise authority only over behavior-bearing semantics within that boundary, and emit one complete policy.

mode_certificate.scope_boundary: The incumbent two-call contract-locked executable lineage is retained; only the direct candidate_hypothesis-to-terminal edge is removed.
mode_certificate.why_not_repeat_role_fission: No call or role is added, renamed, divided, or replicated; the mutation changes one existing evidence edge rather than partitioning terminal work.

qualitative_hypothesis.causal_change: Delete only the direct candidate_hypothesis input edge to the terminal call, making its influence single-use upstream while preserving indirect visibility through the complete executable closure.
qualitative_hypothesis.expected_effect: The terminal authority should preserve executable lineage and contract conformance while avoiding semantic drift caused by a second independent interpretation of the mutation intent.
qualitative_hypothesis.falsifier: all-valid matched majority and strict-median contract, with no score
qualitative_hypothesis.observed_bottleneck: The incumbent gives candidate_hypothesis direct causal authority during both executable-closure construction and terminal behavioral revision, allowing the same intent to be independently reinterpreted twice.

structural_mutation.after: candidate_hypothesis is directly visible only to lock_contract_closure and reaches contract_bounded_behavior_authority solely through the complete executable closure
structural_mutation.before: candidate_hypothesis is directly visible to both lock_contract_closure and contract_bounded_behavior_authority
structural_mutation.factor: single-use candidate-hypothesis authority through deletion of its direct terminal evidence edge
structural_mutation.why_structural: This removes one evidence edge and changes terminal visibility, evidence timing, and causal authority without adding or splitting roles.
